explanation: German table manners favor quiet, controlled eating, so audibly slurping noodles or soup reads as a lapse in manners rather than the sign of enjoyment it can be in East Asian dining culture. It stands out most in formal settings or restaurants.
local_tip: Twirl noodles onto your fork and sip soup quietly from the spoon rather than straight from the bowl.

also_check.note: Slurping noodles is normal and can signal enjoyment of the meal rather than poor manners.
Slurping noodles is common and generally unremarkable, especially in casual settings.
Audibly slurping pasta is considered a clear breach of table manners.
